## Activity on node {#aon}

```{=html}
<figure class="widget"><svg id="aon-svg" viewBox="0 0 1160 380" role="img" aria-label="Activity-on-node network: A leads to B and D; B leads to C and E; C and D lead to F; D and E lead to G; F and G lead to H."></svg></figure>
<script>
window.cellcoCPM = (function () {
  const acts = { A: [3, []], B: [4, ['A']], C: [8, ['B']], D: [5, ['A']], E: [7, ['B']], F: [2, ['C', 'D']], G: [3, ['D', 'E']], H: [2, ['F', 'G']] };
  const pos = { A: [90, 190], B: [300, 100], D: [300, 290], C: [530, 50], E: [530, 190], F: [770, 100], G: [770, 290], H: [1000, 190] };
  const names = { A: 'Survey, permits', B: 'Design', C: 'Containers', D: 'Civil works', E: 'PCS, transformer', F: 'Install containers', G: 'Install PCS, grid', H: 'Commission' };
  function compute(dur) {
    const K = Object.keys(acts), ES = {}, EF = {}, LS = {}, LF = {};
    K.forEach((k) => { ES[k] = Math.max(0, ...acts[k][1].map((p) => EF[p])); EF[k] = ES[k] + dur[k]; });
    const T = Math.max(...K.map((k) => EF[k]));
    [...K].reverse().forEach((k) => { const succ = K.filter((s) => acts[s][1].includes(k)); LF[k] = succ.length ? Math.min(...succ.map((s) => LS[s])) : T; LS[k] = LF[k] - dur[k]; });
    return { K, ES, EF, LS, LF, T };
  }
  function draw(svg, dur, hl) {
    const r = compute(dur), crit = (k) => Math.abs(r.LS[k] - r.ES[k]) < 1e-9;
    let g = '<defs><marker id="ar-' + svg.id + '" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#333F4A"/></marker></defs>';
    r.K.forEach((k) => acts[k][1].forEach((p) => {
      const [x1, y1] = pos[p], [x2, y2] = pos[k], c = crit(k) && crit(p) && Math.abs(r.EF[p] - r.ES[k]) < 1e-9;
      g += `<line x1="${x1 + 70}" y1="${y1}" x2="${x2 - 74}" y2="${y2}" stroke="${c ? '#E29A2D' : '#333F4A'}" stroke-width="${c ? 4 : 2}" marker-end="url(#ar-${svg.id})"/>`;
    }));
    r.K.forEach((k) => {
      const [x, y] = pos[k], c = crit(k);
      g += `<rect x="${x - 70}" y="${y - 36}" width="140" height="72" rx="6" fill="${c ? '#FBF0DE' : '#F3F0EB'}" stroke="${c ? '#E29A2D' : '#0F6E6B'}" stroke-width="${k === hl ? 4 : 2}"/>`;
      g += `<text x="${x}" y="${y - 12}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#1C242B">${k} · ${+dur[k].toFixed(2)} wk</text>`;
      g += `<text x="${x}" y="${y + 10}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#333F4A">${names[k]}</text>`;
      g += `<text x="${x}" y="${y + 29}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#66727C">ES ${+r.ES[k].toFixed(2)} · LS ${+r.LS[k].toFixed(2)}</text>`;
    });
    svg.innerHTML = g; return r;
  }
  const base = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(acts).map(([k, v]) => [k, v[0]]));
  return { compute, draw, base, names };
})();
cellcoCPM.draw(document.getElementById('aon-svg'), cellcoCPM.base);
</script>
```

[Each box is an activity, each arrow a precedence. Boxes and arrows in amber lie on a critical path.]{.note-line}

## Forward and backward pass {#passes}

::: {.two}
::: {}
**Forward pass** (earliest times): ES = largest EF of the predecessors, EF = ES + duration.

**Backward pass** (latest times): LF = smallest LS of the successors, LS = LF − duration.

**Total slack** = LS − ES. Activities with zero slack are **critical**: any delay delays the project.
:::
::: {}
```{=html}
<table class="wide">
  <thead><tr><th>Act.</th><th class="num">ES</th><th class="num">EF</th><th class="num">LS</th><th class="num">LF</th><th class="num">Slack</th></tr></thead>

    <tr><td>B</td><td class="num">3</td><td class="num">7</td><td class="num">3</td><td class="num">7</td><td class="num">0</td></tr>
    <tr><td>C</td><td class="num">7</td><td class="num">15</td><td class="num">7</td><td class="num">15</td><td class="num">0</td></tr>
    <tr><td>D</td><td class="num">3</td><td class="num">8</td><td class="num">9</td><td class="num">14</td><td class="num hit">6</td></tr>
    <tr><td>E</td><td class="num">7</td><td class="num">14</td><td class="num">7</td><td class="num">14</td><td class="num">0</td></tr>
    <tr><td>F</td><td class="num">15</td><td class="num">17</td><td class="num">15</td><td class="num">17</td><td class="num">0</td></tr>
    <tr><td>G</td><td class="num">14</td><td class="num">17</td><td class="num">14</td><td class="num">17</td><td class="num">0</td></tr>
    <tr><td>H</td><td class="num">17</td><td class="num">19</td><td class="num">17</td><td class="num">19</td><td class="num">0</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```

## Activity · Card network {#act1 .activity data-hold="true"}

[Groups of 4 · 20 minutes · activity cards and a large sheet]{.act-label}

::: {.prompt}
Your group receives the eight activity cards in random order. Build the network on the sheet, then run the passes by hand.
:::

1. Place the cards so that every arrow points from a predecessor to its successor.
2. Write ES and EF on each card (forward pass), then LS and LF (backward pass).
3. How long does the project take? Which activities are critical? Which one can slip, and by how much?
4. Gallery walk: check another group's network and correct one error if you find it.

::: {.selfstudy}
Studying alone: do the two passes on paper with the table on the project slide, then compare.
:::

## Activity · Answer {#act1-answer}

::: {.two}
::: {}
The project takes **19 weeks**.

There are **two critical paths**, both 19 weeks long: A-B-C-F-H and A-B-E-G-H.

Only D, civil works, has slack: it can start up to **6 weeks late** without delaying the project.
:::
::: {}
::: {.route-question}
Two critical paths make the plan fragile: a delay on either the containers (C) or the power conversion system (E) delays commissioning. Shortening only one of them gains nothing.
:::
:::
:::

## Change a duration {#cpm-explorer data-hold="true"}

```{=html}
<div class="widget" id="cx">
  <div class="w-controls">
    <label class="w-slider">Activity <select id="cx-a" style="font-size:1em"></select></label>
    <label class="w-slider">Duration, weeks <strong id="cx-dv">8</strong><input type="range" id="cx-d" min="0" max="14" step="1" value="8"></label>
    <button type="button" class="w-btn" id="cx-reset">Reset all</button>
  </div>
  <svg id="cx-svg" viewBox="0 0 1160 380" role="img" aria-label="Project network recomputed with the chosen duration"></svg>
  <div class="w-readout" id="cx-out" aria-live="polite"></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('cx'); if (!root || !window.cellcoCPM) return;
  root.addEventListener('click', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
  const C = window.cellcoCPM, dur = { ...C.base }, sel = document.getElementById('cx-a'), sl = document.getElementById('cx-d');
  sel.innerHTML = Object.keys(dur).map((k) => `<option value="${k}">${k} · ${C.names[k]}</option>`).join(''); sel.value = 'C';
  function draw() {
    const k = sel.value; dur[k] = +sl.value; document.getElementById('cx-dv').textContent = sl.value;
    const r = C.draw(document.getElementById('cx-svg'), dur, k);
    const crit = r.K.filter((a) => Math.abs(r.LS[a] - r.ES[a]) < 1e-9);
    document.getElementById('cx-out').innerHTML = `Project duration: <span class="best">${r.T} weeks</span> (base 19). Critical activities: <b>${crit.join(', ')}</b>. Slack of ${k}: <b>${+(r.LS[k] - r.ES[k]).toFixed(2)} weeks</b>.`;
  }
  sel.addEventListener('change', () => { sl.value = dur[sel.value]; draw(); });
  sl.addEventListener('input', draw);
  document.getElementById('cx-reset').addEventListener('click', () => { Object.assign(dur, C.base); sl.value = dur[sel.value]; draw(); });
  draw();
})();
</script>
```

[Try shortening C from 8 to 6 weeks: the project is still 19 weeks, because A-B-E-G-H stays critical.]{.hint}

## What we learned {#debrief}

::: {.takeaways}
::: {.tk}
An activity-on-node network shows precedence. The forward pass gives the earliest times, the backward pass the latest.
:::
::: {.tk}
CellCo's installation takes 19 weeks, with two critical paths. Only civil works has slack, 6 weeks.
:::
::: {.tk .key}
With parallel critical paths, shortening one activity alone does not shorten the project.
:::
:::

[After lunch, Session 8: uncertain durations, the chance of finishing on time, and paying to finish earlier.]{.note-line}

## Key terms in English and Chinese {#glossary}

::: {.gloss}
| English | 中文 | English | 中文 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Activity on node (AON) | 节点式网络图（单代号网络图） | Latest start (LS) | 最迟开始时间 |
| Precedence | 紧前关系 | Total slack (float) | 总时差 |
| Critical path method (CPM) | 关键路径法 | Critical path | 关键路径 |
| Earliest start (ES) | 最早开始时间 | Forward and backward pass | 正向与逆向计算 |
:::
